description: Content roles and review criteria for the supported slide layouts. Typography and color come from the selected theme; all dimensions are adaptable.

layouts.title: Talk opening
layouts.description: A clear talk identity with a short supporting line and generous space.
review_checks: Do not turn the title into a crowded abstract
Omit the opening page number by default
If a portrait is added, center the face within its crop

layouts.title: Transition question or navigation cue
layouts.description: A short prominent question that opens a real gap, or a large topic cue for Q&A navigation.
use_when: Bridging a finding to a new method

content_roles.title: One short question or topic cue
content_roles.subtitle: Optional brief context

review_checks: The preceding result motivates the question
The question does not simply repeat the next mission statement
Q&A cues remain readable as thumbnails

layouts.title: Focused explanation
layouts.description: A takeaway title followed by a compact set of parallel statements.
review_checks: Each bullet adds a distinct point
Avoid nested small explanations
Use a visual layout when relationships matter more than the list

layouts.title: Aligned comparison
layouts.description: Parallel columns make a meaningful difference easy to locate.
use_when: Showing an error and a corrected result
Comparing evidence under a controlled condition

content_roles.title: What the comparison establishes
content_roles.columns: Named alternatives, each with its own short body
content_roles.subtitle: Optional shared comparison condition

review_checks: Column labels identify the comparison
Related images use comparable scale and aligned captions
Fixed-budget or other conditions are explicit

layouts.title: Parts and contributions
layouts.description: Group work by purpose, with paper names and short descriptions under each part.
use_when: Returning to the roadmap at a part boundary

content_roles.title: Talk mission or roadmap heading
content_roles.parts: Ordered parts with title and papers
content_roles.parts[].papers[].title: Short work name

review_checks: Part and paper hierarchy is obvious
One paper per row where practical
Active-part emphasis and line breaks remain consistent
Do not hardcode three parts if the new story needs a different structure

layouts.title: Research work introduction
layouts.description: Introduce a work and its collaborators with a clean identity page.
use_when: Introducing a substantial project within a longer talk

content_roles.title: Short work name
content_roles.subtitle: Full publication or project title
content_roles.authors: Names and optional portrait images with normalized focal_x/focal_y crop coordinates

review_checks: Full title and venue are accurate
Headshot crops center faces, names center beneath them
Recognition does not collide with authors
Save the detailed research question for the following content
Face focal points are honored by native macOS PNG and Keynote output; SVG-only preview uses a centered fill crop

layouts.title: Contribution and impact synthesis
layouts.description: Organize a small number of verified effects and outcomes with readable hierarchy.
use_when: Presenting adoption, recognition, or open-source evidence

content_roles.title: Impact claim
content_roles.columns: Up to three grouped contributions or metrics
content_roles.subtitle: Optional concise scope

review_checks: Each metric has a recoverable source
Adoption, citation, deployment, and recognition are not conflated
The page can be explained in the intended order
Shorter wording preserves large type

layouts.title: People and thanks
layouts.description: Give people, collaborators, or shared memories the visual focus.

content_roles.title: Warm concise acknowledgement
content_roles.body: Names or a short message when no images are supplied
content_roles.subtitle: Optional message when no images are supplied

review_checks: Faces are not lost to crops
Names align with their photos
Prioritize photos instead of forcing all of them to fit
Personal thanks sound sincere and specific

layouts.title: Narrated visual process
layouts.description: Bind a reusable rendered scene to a slide while preserving a clear title and narration.
use_when: Revealing a framework or assembled output

content_roles.scene: Template ID and content/timing overrides; labels are drawn by the scene
content_roles.notes: Spoken narration corresponding to scene events

review_checks: The scene is scientifically appropriate for this content
Text remains legible inside the movie
Movie autoplay is separate from slide auto-advance
Start/end frames match adjacent slides
Production directions stay outside the spoken notes
Full-bleed scenes own their title; the base layout does not overlay title or page number

layouts.title: Concise research takeaway
layouts.description: A small set of complete contribution statements closes a work and prepares the next step.

content_roles.title: Work-level conclusion
content_roles.body: Brief complete contribution or result bullets
content_roles.subtitle: Optional minimal scope

review_checks: Bullets state the novelty rather than generic benefits
No small explanatory subline is required under each bullet
Claims remain supported by the source
Notes lead naturally to the next question
